title: Barina alal
intro: Danga taxaw ci kanamu jaar-jaaru alal ju bari, dundu gu fees dell ak wurus ak doole, waaye muy luy jàngale képp ku bëgga màgg ci àdduna. Ndax mën nga wax kan mooy nit ki, jaar-jaaram mingi wéy di wéy, di firnde ni moomeeli àdduna du yàgg?
clues: Ci askanu Yonent bu mag laa bokk, waaye dama tànn yoonu réy-réy ak noot.
Allah daf ma jox alal ju bari, ba caabi samay alal nekkoon lu diis ci nit ñu bari ñu am doole.
Sama askan daf ma digal ma baña bànneexu ci sama alal, di fàttali ni Yàlla bëggul ñiy bànneexu.
Ma wax ak réy-réy ni sama alal ju bari ji mingi aju ci sama xam-xam ak sama coono, te du barke bu jóge ci Yàlla.
Dañu ma artu ci ger, di ma fàttali ma sàkku àllaaxira ci li ma Yàlla jox, waaye bañ naa dégg, wéy ci sama réy-réy.
Ginaaw ga Yàlla def suuf si wann ma ak sama dëkkuwaay, bàyyi ma amul kenn ku ma dimbali ci dogalam.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
